name: COMPETITION
description: pointer to the competition database record (its +0 is the competition id); Comp base field
evidence: same Comp base offset as league::COMPETITION (verified); the cup constructors write their record argument there and cup routines read [this+4] then [..+0] as the comp id

name: COMP_STATS
